# Nawabi Hyderabad House

> Nawabi Hyderabad House, located at 4448 E New York St in Aurora, IL, specializes in authentic Hyderabadi Biryani. The restaurant offers a variety of chicken, mutton, and vegetable biryanis, as well as traditional Indian curries and appetizers.

## Menu
Specializes in authentic Hyderabadi Biryani, offering a variety of chicken, mutton, and vegetable biryanis, alongside other traditional Indian curries and appetizers.
